scope: Native visual study of four directly generated originals, prior to integration.

first_attempt.result: 240-second controller timeout; no viewport produced. Process no longer exists. Failure retained.

observations: Ground has fewer high-frequency flecks; unit silhouettes and mountain miniatures are easier to separate from it.
Wuhan remains gray/yellow under its current materials and control layers; city footprints and small-water geometry remain sparse.
Nanjing still has coarse long contour strokes and little urban district detail.
The coastal viewport exposes stair-shaped shore segments and faint rectangular/polygon patches in the ground. Replacing textures alone does not resolve those render/data defects.
decision: Four originals are retained as candidates for integration with geographically gated coverage. Broader terrain, city and coastline work remains required.
